en: The image is a sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a rural village nestled among rolling hills, with cultivated fields and several buildings, including larger estate-like structures. In the background, there are mountains and a prominent cross on a hill. The style of the photograph and the handwritten notes at the bottom suggest an early 20th-century origin. The printed text at the bottom identifies the location as 'Novaline di Mattarello.'
